title: Alex Leonidas inspired Jordan Peters UL PP
author: Dorin G.
desc:
I think this is really good. I ve put some thought into it try it and you get really good recovery. The optional day is not mandatory. And I don’t think you should do it every week maybe when you have more gas in you
So mostly keep the 4 days and get big numbers on the compounds

ex.note:
Key lift to push progression. Have a good arch and do a slight pause at the bottom.
Switch variation to avoid overuse. 
Variations Weighted Dips/ Close Grip Bench

Full ROM 
Switch Grips for overuse and try to get strong at more grips. Typically overhand on this day.
Increase weight even by 1.25kg .
Key lift for the back. Make this your religion✝️

Strict 
Standing or AD PRESS Maybe smith machine
Control it on eccentric. Don’t drop it

Upper back row focus variation
Chest supported machines will work great 
Focus on the stretch

More focus on the upper chest 
Maybe a machine chest press or incline fly TNF style 
Focus on the target muscle. Try to make it with purpose

Reverse Pec Deck 
Reverse Flys 
Max effort for the rear delts

Machine preacher or preacher with DB on incline bench 
Push very hard

Try to focus on long head.
Overhead triceps extension GVS style intensity.
Get very strong at it.
Maybe switch French Press or DB incline Skullcrusher

Main lift for leg growth 
If knees or low back not feeling 100%
Smith or Hack Squat
Don’t rush the reps.

Hypertension or DB RDL
Focus on the negative. Pause in the stretch. Progress over time.

Secondary quad movement 
Focus on the depth 
Smith machine if you didn’t do that earlier 
Push all the way.

Treat it like it’s life or death 
Don’t scream like Dr Mike🤣
Same as the leg curls. This is the last quad work make it count bro

Stretch !!!!
And go heavy don’t kid yourself

Focus on flexion of the spine and push progression 
Goal the full stack easily
As much time as you cand so you cand decompress and get some grip work

This is your other main lift for chest. Also you can rotate with Smith Incline or incline DB for variation 
Full Rom slight pause

Past failure Rest pause 
Hold the squeeze

Conventional not recommended but cam work maybe rarely
Stiff leg or RDL
Focus on negative and you want to push progression

Neutral or chin up usually 
Just don’t do the same one as Monday 
Full ROM
Upper back focus can use the same one as Monday

DB or cable but machine preferred 
Destroy the lats push failure bro big back
